What to look for: DXC does not finish. Compiler Explorer reports
"Killed - processing time exceeded" rather than any diagnostic.

  DXC   never terminates. A local release build was still running after five
        minutes; a debug build trips an LLVM assert instead, on the same input.
  Clang compiles the same source cleanly.

The trigger is the empty struct Helper reached through inheritance: Parent
holds a Helper, Child derives from Parent and calls a method on it. Give
Helper a member and the hang goes away.

Restated as a compute shader so Clang can run the same source; the issue's
original repro is a ps_6_0 and hangs identically.
